title: Q4 Webinar Series Planning
description: Marketing, product, finance and customer success plan a four-webinar Q4 series with budget and attribution rules.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Thanks for joining, everyone. This is planning for the Q4 webinar series. The goal is pipeline. I want 600 thousand dollars in influenced pipeline from webinars by year end.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: And what budget are you asking for? I have 42 thousand in the draft and want to confirm it's the same number you have.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Yes, 42 thousand across four webinars, so roughly ten and a half each, including ads, a production vendor, and speaker gifts.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Four seems like a lot with a launch to support. Can we justify four?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: I think so, if each has a different job. First, the launch webinar on October 28th, a week after Insights 2.0 ships. That's the demo-heavy one.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Second, a customer story on November 12th. Third, an anomaly alerts how-to on December 3rd for existing customers. Fourth, a year-in-review and roadmap on December 17th.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Fine in principle. I'll want the numbers behind the funnel before I sign anything.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: For the customer story, I'd love Brightpath Health. They signed last month and a healthcare analytics story would stand out. But they won't have results by November 12th.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: They'll barely be live. I'd rather do their story in January with real numbers. Who else could we use for November?

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Cobalt Commerce has been a customer for 18 months, and their 22 percent conversion lift is a real number.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Cobalt is e-commerce, which is our biggest segment, so I like it for pipeline. Diego, can you ask them?

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Sure. I'll reach out to Cobalt's head of growth by Wednesday and see if they'll present.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: And we keep Brightpath as the Q1 story.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: For the launch webinar, I'll do the live demo, and I'll ask Tobias to join for the Q&A.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Perfect. I'd like a dry run on October 26th.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Put it on my calendar.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Promotion. LinkedIn ads at 12 thousand over the quarter, email to our list of 18,400 contacts, and co-promotion with two integration partners.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: What conversion are you assuming from the email list?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Conservatively a 2 percent registration rate, so about 370 per webinar from email alone. Add paid and partners and I think we land at 400 to 450 registrants per webinar, around 1,700 total.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Are the two partners committed, or still talking?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: One has signed. The other is a verbal yes for now.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Show-up rate?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: 38 percent live, plus on-demand recordings. Last quarter we hit 41, so 38 is safe.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: And SQLs?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: About 8 percent of attendees, so around 50 for the series.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Fifty SQLs at our average deal size of 18 thousand and a 20 percent close rate is roughly 180 thousand in closed revenue against 42 thousand spent. I can live with that, but I want attribution by webinar.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: I'll build an attribution dashboard in Lumora itself. We should dogfood it.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Love that. We could even feature it in the launch.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Then I'll approve the 42 thousand on one condition: release the LinkedIn spend in two tranches, the second after the first webinar.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: That's fair.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Production. I'd like a vendor for the launch webinar, around 6,500 for run-of-show, moderation, and a clean recording. The others we do in house.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: The risk is the launch date. If Insights 2.0 slips, a webinar on the 28th is awkward.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: I've thought about that. If the launch slips by a week, I'd move the webinar to November 4th, so I'll hold both dates with the vendor.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Hold both, but don't pay deposits until the launch is confirmed.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Understood. The vendor allows cancellation with seven days' notice and no penalty, which is why I'm comfortable holding both.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: Should we record all four and put the replays behind a form?

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Yes, replays behind a form. That's where a lot of SQLs come from.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: Customer success can help with registrants too. I could email 60 key accounts personally.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Please do. I'll send you a sample note with the registration link by Monday.

transcript.speaker: me
transcript.text: I'll draft the demo script and get it to you before the dry run, by October 19th.

transcript.speaker: diego
transcript.text: And I'll send those 60 personal emails once the registration page is open.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: Let me restate the decisions. Four webinars, 42 thousand total, LinkedIn spend in two tranches, attribution by webinar. Customer story is Cobalt in November, Brightpath in Q1.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Yes. I'll write the series plan and share a one-pager with everyone by next Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: I'll also open the registration page for the October 28th webinar by October 1st.

transcript.speaker: fatima
transcript.text: And I'll release the first tranche of the LinkedIn spend once Helena sends the plan.

transcript.speaker: helena
transcript.text: Great. Thanks, everyone.

summary.overview: The group planned a four-webinar Q4 series with a 42 thousand dollar budget and a goal of 600 thousand dollars in influenced pipeline. The topics are the Insights 2.0 launch demo on October 28th, a Cobalt Commerce customer story on November 12th, an anomaly alerts how-to on December 3rd, and a year-in-review on December 17th, with Brightpath Health saved for a Q1 story. Helena projected around 1,700 registrants and about 50 SQLs, and Fatima approved the budget with LinkedIn spend released in two tranches and attribution tracked per webinar. A backup date of November 4th is held in case the launch slips.
